PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Fund operations professional with 8+ years in investment banking, managing private equity, private credit, real estate, 
hedge, and debt funds. Specializes in fund valuations, capital account tracking, and investor reporting, with a background in 
portfolio reconciliation and portfolio management support. Skilled in processing capital calls, distributions, and NAV, with 
a strong track record of accurate, deadline-driven reporting and client relationship management.

◗ Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Hedge & Debt Fund Operations • Fund Valuations & Capital Accounts
◗ Fund Accounting • Cash Flow Analysis • Investment Banking
◗ Financial Reporting • Portfolio Reconciliation • Asset Management • Accounting • Corporate Actions
◗ Trade Settlements • Accounts Payable • Invoice Processing • Wire Transfers & Cash Management
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
◗ Microsoft Excel (Advanced) • Microsoft Word • Microsoft PowerPoint • AI Copilot Tools
◗ Fund Operations Platforms: Efront • Portfolio Center

Bangalore, Karnataka

◗ Coordinated invoice processing and purchase order generation with the Accounts Payable team, synchronizing

◗ Responded to tax audit requests by preparing and submitting required documentation within specified timelines,
supporting a clean audit trail.
